name: Amane Ruru
source: The current Orihime candidate of the Tower of Destiny. She is a laidback girl who sleeps a lot. Ruru can use singing magic, but it has many side-effects: she must sleep a lot, in fact, 10 hours per day and she has very low blood pressure due to this. Known also as the Diva of the School. Her hobby is making stuffed animals.
